title: Packs, GADT variant results, and package roles are not implemented: a pack function is `unsupported-generic-parameter`, `pack.map` is an unknown name, and GADT results and package roles get generic diagnostics

Method references (Method References MR1-MR4, MR6) are implemented, but a closure in a generic function cannot call a method through the enclosing function's bounds, so `T::label` fails, and `List[void]`, which one fixture's result type names, is still an unknown type

The `@error` intrinsic (Error Conversion decision 10) and its batch 9, 11, and 13 codes, bounds, and scope (decisions 21-31) are not implemented: the prototype resolves `@error` as an ordinary decorator, so it derives no `Display`, `Error`, or `From`, and `@from` and `@source` are unknown names
Embedding simplification cannot be fully exercised: the prototype compiles one module without trait imports, so trait availability is untested, and the fixtures need package roles
Visibility-aware member lookup cannot be exercised: the prototype compiles one module, so every own member is visible, and the fixtures need package roles
The trait-argument ownership fixture for a foreign trait argument needs package roles, which the prototype lacks
Typed derivation M29's per-trait Self-line warning needs a second package, and the prototype CLI has no package roles
The `disposed-file` runtime profile named in spec/conformance/README.md does not exist
An initialization group's statements are not interleaved: the package linker joins the group's modules by identity, so a read of a later-joined module's binding fails
The prototype has no pack operations, so `pack.map(` on a local named `pack` resolves as a method call
A script's top-level println needs the inferred script entry requirement row, which the prototype does not infer
A parenthesized `:=` list as a same-line suite body (batch 15, Q1a) is not implemented: the parser still requires an indented body
The nested multi-name binding `((a, b) := value)` (batch 15, Q1b) is not implemented: the parser still reads only the dropped grouped form `(a, b := value)`
The `redundant-let-mut` warning for a list name whose annotated element is already `mut` (batch 15, LM-a) is not implemented
Inside a closure, the collision check (batch 15, PS3a) does not compare the closure's declared row with keys its own `$.with` binds
